rows.question: I've got a cashback deal and a bonus-data deal - can both be applied when I top up once?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "If not, raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references; approved refunds are credited to the original payment method or as account balance" [D1]. "Detailed Explanation Auto-detection is the default path (3-5 working days), and the manual ticket route exists specifically as the fallback for when auto-detection doesn't catch it — the two transaction references are needed precisely because it's a duplicate-charge case, so the system needs to see both transactions to link them" [D1].

rows.question: Once NovaTel agrees to give the money back, when does it land if I paid by UPI?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "The two refund destinations have different timelines because they involve different systems — refunds to source (card/UPI/net banking) depend partly on the bank's own processing time on top of NovaTel's approval, while refunds to NovaTel Wallet or account balance stay entirely within NovaTel's systems, which is why they're much faster" [D1]. "Short Answer Once approved, refunds to source (card/UPI/net banking) generally reflect within 5-7 working days, subject to your bank's processing time" [D1].

rows.question: Can I get a fixed public address for my home internet so I can reach my devices remotely?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "This is explicitly a paid add-on rather than a standard feature, and the answer notes the intended use case — hosting or remote access — which explains why it isn't offered as default: most home broadband use doesn't need a fixed address exposed to the internet, but specific technical use cases do" [D1]. "Short Answer Static IP is available as a paid add-on on select broadband plans, primarily intended for hosting/remote-access use cases" [D1].

rows.question: Does NovaTel offer any help for customers who can't hear well?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "Short Answer We offer SMS-based/relay customer support, a dedicated accessible IVR flow, and large-print/audio billing formats" [D1]. "What happens: Since NovaTel never asks for OTPs over a call, this is inherently suspicious regardless of how convincing the caller sounds, and can be reported via Help > Report Fraud in the app" [D3].

rows.question: How do I stop telemarketing texts and calls by sending a message?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "Short Answer Send 'START 0' via SMS to the DND short code (or use Help > DND Preferences in the app) to block all commercial communication, or 'START' followed by a category code to block specific categories only, per TRAI's DND regulations" [D1].

rows.question: How many months do my loyalty points stay valid, and what can I use them for?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "Short Answer Loyalty points accrued through tenure and recharge activity are visible under Rewards in the app and can be redeemed for data vouchers, partner discounts, or plan upgrades" [D1]. "Points typically expire 12 months after being credited if unused" [D1].

rows.question: Two of my connections are under separate profiles - how do I put them together, and how long does it take?
rows.answer: Here is what the retrieved documents say: "Merging is restricted to accounts belonging to the same KYC-verified person specifically because it changes who is legally associated with which connections — that's also why it goes through a request-and-review flow (3-5 working days) rather than being instant like a profile-field edit" [D1]. "Short Answer Account merging is supported only for connections held by the same KYC-verified individual" [D1].

rows.question: How do I turn on fingerprint unlock for the NovaTel app, and does it carry over to my other phones?

"What happens: Whether they visit a store with photo ID or complete video-KYC in the app, the number and remaining balance/plan carry over unchanged, and the replacement is typically issued instantly" [D2].
